verdict.rationale: The evidence documents event-triggered automation, such as offboarding triggering device retrieval and role changes updating access, plus a generic claim to "Automate workflows across systems." Nothing shows time-based or recurring scheduling of jobs or workflows. An event-triggered or one-off action is not a recurring schedule, so these are adjacent features only and the axis remains unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: The instant an employee is offboarded in Rippling, AI triggers the retrieval flow and generates the shipping label, dispatches the box, and tracks the return.
